body:
Hi! Thanks for the contribution.

I think I get the fix: instead of pushing "null" as the state of the history API, you want to push some default value needed by your app to work?

If that's it, then I will make it a proper generic non-turbolinks related option that other people could use (like instantsearch({getHistoryState: function() { return {turboLinks: true} }}).

What do you think?
